Help

Main menu
Make new score opens a blank editor. Import accepts note names, supported ABC notation, or a project backup. View existing scores lists saved projects. Playable notes opens the keyboard and fingering chart. Main menu returns home.
Score Editor
Save score keeps the title, source or author, pitches, and timing in this browser. Export project backup downloads a file you can reimport. Add pasted notes appends pitches. The pitch and beats controls edit the selected note. Insert after selection adds a note, Move earlier/later changes its order, and Remove note or Delete on a selected card deletes it. Right-click a card for note actions. Swap note lets you hear replacement pitches before confirming and keeps the note’s timing.
Playback
Click a note block to hear and select it. Press Enter to replay it, then tap again for each next note. Arrow keys move the selection silently. Play all follows the score rhythm, updates the fingering diagram, and highlights the staff while you scroll freely. Stop ends playback, Loop repeats the song, and Playback speed scales the tempo.
Microphone tools
Ocarina tuner shows your pitch, tuning and fingering. Play Along opens a fingering-only practice view. Start the microphone, play the blue fingering, and it turns green when matched. Briefly release between repeated notes. Pause stops listening and keeps your place. Convert sound listens to one note at a time and captures pitches and timing. Leave a short, clear break between repeated pitches. Stop capture shows your take. Add captured notes appends it to the editor for playback and correction.
Recording and notation
Record Enter timing measures time between taps. Finish recording ends a take early. View and edit notation opens the staff and note table. Apply tempo to captured timing recalculates the written beats. Use these durations for Play all applies the edited beats. Use exact recorded intervals plays back your measured timing.
Export and share
Export → Music score offers an engraved PDF and editable ABC. Copy for chat copies notation and any measured timings. Export → Ocarina tabs opens the tab layout editor. Preview or download large fingerings with the written rhythm underneath, or copy the codes for Ocarina Tabs Creator.
Playable notes
Click a pitch or press its displayed letter. The diagram below the keyboard shows the fingering. Filled holes are covered and open circles are uncovered.

Sequence notePitchBeatsTime to next note

Click a note to select it. Enter plays it, then each subsequent Enter moves forward and plays the next note. Left/Up go back and Right/Down go forward. Hold a note button to sustain it. Press Delete on a selected card to remove it, or right-click it for more actions.
